_note: Flagship 3: every spoken line, exactly as in script/SCRIPT.md (the locked script, field 'text'). 'slot' is the locked slot on the 120 BPM bar grid (bar = 2.0 s); a voice line sits inside its slot with at least 0.25 s of silence at each end. English 'say' is the text given to the synthesiser when it differs (letters spelled, names pronounced). Japanese 'kana' is the AquesTalk-style reading given to VOICEVOX: katakana, ' after the accent nucleus, / accent-phrase boundary, 、 pause, _ devoiced vowel (the long-vowel mark is written as a doubled vowel). Japanese lines L5 to L8 do not fit their slots as locked even at the maximum rate (1.22) with short pauses: 'use' is 'cut' and the audio and subtitles use field 'cut' (the shortest cut found, no change of meaning, honesty words kept). This is a PROPOSAL for the lead to accept or reject; set 'use' to 'exact' to render the locked text (it then overruns its slot, see audio/vo-timing.json). tools: audio/make_voice.py reads this file.

lines.text: One wrong curve — and the steel doesn't fit.
So before you cut: how do you know?
NEXUS FABRIC. Dimensions in. Flat pattern out.
lines.say: Nexus Fabric. Dimensions in. Flat pattern out.

lines.text: Shells. Cones. Eccentric reducers. Branches. Headers with their openings. Every cut computed, point by point.
Then it checks its own work. Folded back in 3D, both edges must be one curve.
The DXF is written, read back, and compared.
lines.say: The D X F is written, read back, and compared.

lines.text: Underneath runs AMOEBA. Every value and every step is recorded and linked. Change one number — and everything that depended on it is flagged for review. Replay a job, and it must match.
lines.say: Underneath runs Amoeba. Every value and every step is recorded and linked. Change one number, and everything that depended on it is flagged for review. Replay a job, and it must match.

lines.text: What it cannot confirm, it shows. The result stays: review required.
In English and Japanese. And it runs fully offline.
NEXUS FABRIC. Engineering, reimagined.
